## What example or feature would you like to see?

A clear description of the component or example you'd like added.

## Why would it be useful?

Who would benefit and in what context (embedded UI, avionics, desktop HMI, etc.)?

## Reference or inspiration

Links to Qt documentation, other repos, or screenshots that illustrate what you have in mind.

## Would you be willing to contribute it?

- [ ] Yes, I can open a PR
- [ ] No, just a suggestion
